button-system.note: Specification of a family; no standalone ButtonSystem export.

number-field.note: Public NumberField composes TextField and has its own numeric instance contract.

inline-toolbar.note: Shared toolbar shell; children own their component tokens. No dedicated component token branch.

split-view.note: Panel layout/resize primitive. No dedicated component token branch.

text.note: Public typography role renderer; uses foundation typography and semantic text roles.

icon.note: Public original-glyph renderer. No standalone component spec or colour branch.

text.scope: Recorded typography review; not acceptance of every role/platform.

text-area.scope: Recorded input and visual review; current full Figma/OS/AT acceptance remains open.

link.scope: Recorded Link review; not full current screen acceptance.

select.scope: Validation state implementation and bounded proofs.

text-field.scope: Field validation state implementation and bounded proofs.

number-field.scope: Numeric buffer and field validation proofs; not full locale/OS/AT acceptance.

relatedPlatformEvidence.scope: Historical Lab, Files and Building browser checks; not current acceptance of all components or desktop shells.
